violations.text: Allergen statement is lacking on menus and/or point of sale. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

A dish sponge was observed in the hand-washing sink in the service area; spray bottles and a rag were observed hanging on the handwashing sink in the kitchen. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. All ites were removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Tahini was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit above the fill line in the prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
Establishment is using Time as a Public Health Control for filled croissants without approval. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
Wet wiping cloths are not stored in a chemical sanitizer between uses. Wet wiping cloths must be stored in a chemical sanitizer at the appropriate concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Per PIC, open-top prep unit is in poor repair. PIC stated unit does not maintain temperatures 41 degrees F or colder and leaks frequently. Inspector observed proper temperatures and no evidence of leaks at the time of this inspection; excess condensation was observed around the hotel pans. PIC is working with vendor for a replacement unit. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
The door to the staff toilet room is not self-closing. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2026

Establishment presently does not have refuse removal services. Per PIC, lease space for dumpster has been canceled. PIC is working to secure new location for dumpster services. Trash is being removed daily in personal trash until resolved. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
The door to the staff toilet room is not self-closing. Staff left to obtain appropriate hardware during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 02/20/2026
Establishment does not have on-site garbage facilities. Establishment must obtain appropriate garbage removal services prior to opening to the public. New Violation. Correct By: 02/28/2026
The following were observed in poor repair: -tile under 3-bay sink -coving near electrical panel -hole in coving near 3-bay sink -leak at faucet at 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 03/20/2026
